arcaneShatter.name: Arcane Shatter
arcaneShatter.description: Gain {{energy}} energy per melee hit and {{heal}} max health. When Arcane Shield breaks, deal {{damage;%}} more damage and stun enemies within {{blocks}} for {{ticks}}.

dimensionalWarp.name: Dimensional Warp
dimensionalWarp.description: Gain {{energy}} max energy. You will be warped back at {{heal;%}} health upon taking lethal damage. Reduce Time Warp’s duration by {{ticks}} but gain {{speed;%}} movement speed and {{damage;%}} damage for the duration. Warping back from lethal damage does not drop the flag.

burstChain.name: Burst Chain
burstChain.description:
Lose {{heal}} max health but gain {{speed;%}} base speed. Reduce Time Warp's and Arcane Shield's cooldowns by {{ticks}}. Increase Flame Burst's speed by {{speed;%}} and it guarantees at least {{red}} critical hit. Inferno now allows you to deal {{damage;%}} more damage to enemies without the given damage reducing abilities active:

Last Stand
Ice Barrier
Arcane Shield
Prism Guard
Intervene
Solitary
Ice Block
Contagious Facade
Mystic Barrier

flameBreath.name: Shotgun Pyro
flameBreath.description: Replace Flame Burst with Flame Breath. Replace Time Warp with Time Surge.

frostMissile.name: Frost Missile
frostMissile.description: Increase the damage of Frostbolt by {{damage;%}} and the direct hit damage bonus by {{damage;%}}.

arcaneRecluse.name: Arcane Recluse
arcaneRecluse.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Increase the duration of Arcane Shield by {{ticks}} and the absorption by {{damageReduction;%}}.

chillyAura.name: Chilly Aura
chillyAura.description: Ice Barrier now slows enemies within {{blocks}} by {{speed;%}} and deals {{heal;%}} of their maximum health every {{ticks}}.

steadfastWarp.name: Steadfast Warp
steadfastWarp.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Decrease the absorption of Arcane Shield absorption by {{damageReduction;%}}. Reduce the healing of Time Warp by {{heal;%}}, but you heal for the greater of its normal amount and your pre-Warp health. After {{ticks}}, you can recast to instantly warp back. You gain full knockback immunity during the initial warp, but recasting the warp reduces that duration by {{ticks}}.

blizzardBreath.name: Blizzard Breath
blizzardBreath.description: Freezing Breath reduces the cooldown of all your skills by {{ticks;%}} for each enemy hit and grants immunity to knockback and stun for {{ticks}}.

typhoonBolt.name: Typhoon Bolt
typhoonBolt.description: Increase the healing of Water Bolt by {{heal;%}}.

fortifiedAegis.name: Fortified Aegis
fortifiedAegis.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Reduce the cooldown of Arcane Shield cooldown by {{ticks}}. Upon expiring, Arcane Shield explodes, dealing knockback to enemies within {{blocks}}.

clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
clairvoyance.description: Gain {{energy}} max energy. Replace Time Warp with Clairvoyance. Reduce the duration of Healing Rain by {{ticks}}, but increase the healing by {{heal;%}}.

arcaneReflection.name: Arcane Reflection
arcaneReflection.description: Increase the duration of Arcane Shield by {{ticks}} and for its duration gain {{speed;%}} speed and reflects {{damage;%}} of the damage you take back at the enemy. Increase melee damage by {{damage;%}} and damage of Water Bolt by {{damage;%}}.

divinePurification.name: Divine Purification
divinePurification.description: Water Breath cleanses debuffs and grants those healed immunity to true debuffs for {{ticks}}, and decrease the cooldown by {{ticks;%}} and the energy cost by {{energy;%}}. Arcane Shield costs {{energy}} energy.

goliath.name: Goliath
goliath.description: Gain {{heal}} max health and {{energy}} max energy. Increase Berserk's cooldown by {{ticks}}, it heals you for {{heal}} true healing upon activation.

efficientStrikes.name: Efficient Strikes
efficientStrikes.description: Reduce the energy cost of Wounding Strike by {{energy}}.

mightyFists.name: Mighty Fists
mightyFists.description: Increase the wounding inflicted by Wounding Strike by {{damage;%}}. Each consecutive strike on a target increases the wounding by an additional {{damage;%}}, up to {{damage;%}}. While Berserk is active, Seismic Wave and Ground Slam inflict {{damage;%}} wounding for {{ticks}}.

bloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
bloodFrenzy.description: Reduce the cooldown of Bloodlust by {{ticks}}, the duration by {{ticks}}, and the energy cost by {{energy}}. Reduce its damage converted to healing by {{heal;%}} but it now heals an additional {{heal;%}} based on damage before any reductions.

seismicShift.name: Seismic Shift
seismicShift.description: Reduce the cooldown of Seismic Wave by {{ticks}} and it now applies {{damage;%}} wounding for {{ticks}}.

heroicIntervention.name: Heroic Intervention
heroicIntervention.description: Increase the max damage redirected of Intervene by {{damageReduction;}}, the duration by {{ticks}}, and the cast and break range by {{blocks}}.

striker.name: Striker
striker.description: Increase the damage of Wounding Strike by {{damage;%}} and the wounding by {{damage;%}}.

solitary.name: Solitary
solitary.description: Replace Last Stand with Solitary. Gain {{damageReduction;%}} knockback resistance.

ferventForce.name: Fervent Force
ferventForce.description: Reduce the cooldown of Seismic Wave and Ground Slam by {{ticks;%}}.

vitalityBoost.name: Vitality Boost
vitalityBoost.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Receive {{heal;%}} more healing. Reduce the cooldown of Last Stand by {{ticks}}.

vibrantOrbs.name: Vibrant Orbs
vibrantOrbs.description: Increase the healing of Orbs of Life by {{heal;%}}.

recklessAscent.name: Reckless Ascent
recklessAscent.description: Increase the radius of Reckless Charge by {{blocks}}, the range by {{blocks}}. Gain {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction for {{ticks}} after casting Reckless Charge. Reckless Charge can ascend vertically, but you take {{damage}} when moving vertically.

undyingSteed.name: Undying Steed
undyingSteed.description: Increase the damage of Crippling Strike by {{damage;%}}. Your horse will always be available when you respawn. You can take up to {{damage}} damage on your horse without dismounting.

healingLink.name: Healing Link
healingLink.description: Replace Reckless Charge with Healing Link.

oneManArmy.name: One Man Army
oneManArmy.description: Increase the duration of Undying Army by {{ticks}} and the cooldown by {{ticks}}. Undying Army will no longer heal you, no longer damage you after being popped, and does not apply to allies.

vigorousInfusion.name: Vigorous Infusion
vigorousInfusion.description: Increases the speed granted by Light Infusion by {{speed;%}} and the duration by {{ticks}}. Reduce the cooldown by {{ticks}}.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.description: Increase the damage of Avenger’s Strike by {{damage;%}} and the energy removal by {{energy}}.

wardingWrath.name: Shaq Attack
wardingWrath.description: Gain a {{damageReduction}} health shield each time you strike an enemy. Increase the radius of Avenger’s Wrath by {{blocks}} and the shield health gained to {{damageReduction}} while active. Shield granted do not expire or have a limit.

armOfTheAlmighty.name: Arm of the Almighty
armOfTheAlmighty.description: Your strikes will now cleave up to {{blue}} enemies within {{blocks}} for {{damage;%}} damage and will remove {{energy}} energy.

unstoppableSurge.name: Unstoppable Surge
unstoppableSurge.description: Light Infusion heals you for {{heal}} health, increase the speed granted by {{speed;%}} and the duration by {{ticks}}. Gain permanent {{speed;%}} slow resistance and {{damageReduction;%}} knockback resistance.

markedForDeath.name: Marked for Death
markedForDeath.description: Avenger’s Mark deals {{damage}} damage, and slows by {{speed;%}} and increases damage taken by {{damage;%}} for {{ticks}}. Each Avenger's Strike increases the duration of Avenger’s Mark by {{ticks}}, up to {{ticks}}. Reduce the cooldown of Holy Radiance by {{ticks}} and it costs {{energy}} energy.

lustrousCrown.name: Lustrous Crown
lustrousCrown.description: Reduce the duration of Hammer of Light by {{ticks}}, but increase the radius of Crown of Light by {{blocks}}, the healing by {{heal;%}}, and gain {{speed;%}} speed for its duration.

divineEffulgence.name: Divine Effulgence
divineEffulgence.description: Increase the healing of Holy Radiance by {{heal;%}} and the travel speed by {{speed;%}}. Holy Radiance reduces incoming ranged damage on healed targets by {{damageReduction;%}} for {{ticks}}.

bigGuy.name: Big Guy
bigGuy.description: Gain {{heal}} max health and {{energy;}} max energy. Protector's Strike now heals you for {{heal;%}} and allies for {{heal;%}}.

hammerOfJudgement.name: Hammer of Judgement
hammerOfJudgement.description: Increase the cooldown of Hammer of Light by {{ticks}}. Upon cast, enemies within {{blocks}} take {{damage}} damage and will be Consecrated for {{ticks}}. Consecrated enemies cannot be hit by your Consecrate.

ecoDrive.name: Eco Drive
ecoDrive.description: Reduce the energy cost of Holy Radiance by {{energy}}. Reduce the cooldown of Light Infusion by {{ticks}}. If your strike heals only one ally, you are both healed for {{heal;%}} extra.

galvanizedSpark.name: Galvanized Spark
galvanizedSpark.description: Increase the charges of Lightning Rod to {{blue}}, reduce the cooldown by {{ticks}}, the healing by {{heal;%}}, the energy granted by {{energy}}, and the knockback inflicted. Lightning Rod resets the cooldown of Chain Lightning and grants {{speed;%}} speed for {{ticks}}. Reduce the damage of Capacitor Totem by {{damage}}.

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.description: Increase the damage of Lightning Bolt by {{damage;%}}.

electromagneticChains.name: Nerfinator
electromagneticChains.description: Reduce the damage of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by {{damageReduction;%}}. Chain Lightning reduces the damage enemies deal by {{damageReduction;%}} for {{ticks}}. This effect stacks up to {{blue}} times.

eyeOfTheStorm.name: Eye of the Storm
eyeOfTheStorm.description: Reduce the range of Lightning Bolt to {{blocks}}, but increase the speed by {{speed;%}} and it will violently explode upon expiration or ground contact, with a {{blocks}} splash radius. Increase the Chain Lightning cooldown reduction from Lightning Bolt by {{ticks}}. Capacitor totem can be casted to where you are looking (up to {{blocks}}), instantly procs on cast, and Lightning Rod always procs it.

symphonicWindfury.name: Triple Tap
symphonicWindfury.description: Increase the number of guaranteed hits of Windfury Weapon by {{blue}}. Windfury Weapon ignores passive damage reduction, and upon cast cleanses all slowness effects, grants immunity to slows and knockback, and {{speed;%}} speed for {{ticks}}.

acceleratedSpike.name: Dirt Torpedo
acceleratedSpike.description: Remove the knockback from Earthen Spike, but increase the speed by {{speed;%}}, the cast range by {{blocks}} farther, the hit radius to {{blocks}}, and the damage by {{damage;%}}. Gain {{energy}} max energy.

megalithicBoulder.name: Megalithic Boulder
megalithicBoulder.description: Increase the damage of Boulder by {{damage;%}}. Increase the Boulder cooldown reduction from Chain Heal by {{ticks}}.

earthboundInfusion.name: Earthbound Infusion
earthboundInfusion.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Increase the number of guaranteed hits of Earthliving Weapon by {{blue}} and the healing by {{heal}} if you are the only player healed.

augmentedChains.name: Augmented Chains
augmentedChains.description: Earthen Spike reduces the cooldown of Chain Heal by {{ticks}} upon hitting a target. Increase the healing of Chain Heal by {{heal;%}}.

totemicBoon.name: Urgent Care
totemicBoon.description: Healing totem has {{heal;%}} less healing, {{energy;%}} less energy cost, {{ticks;%}} less cooldown, gets {{blue}} charges, the rate of Healing Totem is increased by {{blue:;x}}, and the radius by {{blocks}}. Within the totem, any allies whose health is greater than {{heal;%}} will transfer their healing to the lowest health ally.

crusadersMight.name: Crusader's Might
crusadersMight.description: Increase the damage of Crusader’s Strike by {{damage;%}}.

parry.name: Parry
parry.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Increase the energy granted by Crusader's Strike by {{energy}}. Replace Consecrate with Parry, which has {{blue}} charges.

rallyingPresence.name: Rallying Presence
rallyingPresence.description: Reduce the duration of Inspiring Presence by {{ticks}} but increase the energy per second granted by {{energy}} and the speed granted by {{speed;%}}.

sovereignSolitude.name: Solo Support
sovereignSolitude.description: Increase the energy granted by Crusader’s Strike by {{energy}} and allow it to grant energy while striking through Arcane Shield, but it only grants to 1 ally. A marked ally gains {{speed;%}} movement speed and is the only one that will receive energy even if allies are nearby. This ally will receive the energy until a new ally is marked, even if the original mark expires. Reduce the cooldown of Holy Radiance by {{ticks}}.

penitentResolve.name: Restraint
penitentResolve.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Repentance now also heals you for {{heal}} every second for the first {{ticks}}, but stops healing if you land a melee hit.

permeatingLink.name: Permeating Link
permeatingLink.description: Gain {{damage;%}} melee damage. Spirit Link reduces {{damageReduction;%}} less damage but deals {{damage;%}} more damage to Soulbound targets.

farmerBrown.name: Farmer Brown
farmerBrown.description: Gain {{speed;%}} slow resistance. Increase soulbind proc knockback resistance by {{damageReduction;%}}. Active ability timers cannot be reduced.

haze.name: Haze
haze.description: Replace Order of Eviscerate with Haze.

trickster.name: Trickster
trickster.description: Reduce the bonus damage threshold of Incendiary Curse by {{damage;%}}, increase the damage by {{damage}}, and the energy cost by {{energy}}. Soul Switch grants invisibility for {{ticks}}, and leaves behind a dummy for {{ticks}} that has {{heal}} health and will damage enemies for how much they deal to it. Shadow Leap will now heal if you are below {{heal}} health.

torrentialSoul.name: Torrential Soul
torrentialSoul.description: Gain {{energy}} max energy. Remove the energy cost of Soul Switch. Order of Eviscerate grants {{speed;%}} more speed and {{energy}} energy per second while it is active.

blink.name: Blink
blink.description: Replace Soul Switch with Blink, which has {{blue}} charges.

riftAmbush.name: Rift Ambush
riftAmbush.description: Soul Switch will now only teleport you to your target and deal {{damage}} true damage. Increase the range of Soul Switch by {{blocks}}, and the damage reduction by {{damageReduction;%}}. The target will be trapped in a {{blocks}} radius for {{ticks}}.

auraOfRestoration.name: Aura of Restoration
auraOfRestoration.description: Increase the cooldown of Soothing Elixir by {{ticks}} and the healing over time by {{heal}}, which will now always affecting allies within the splash radius, even while moving. Increase the break range of Remedic Chains by {{blocks}}.

alchemistsFury.name: Alchemist's Fury
alchemistsFury.description: Soothing Elixir's puddle no longer heals allies. Decrease the cooldown by {{ticks}}, double the projectile speed, increase the damage by {{damage;%}}, and the radius by {{blocks}}. Volatile Brew does full damage when activated early.

sustainedOnslaught.name: Sustained Onslaught
sustainedOnslaught.description: Gain {{speed;%}} more speed. Vitality Concoction heals you for {{heal}} health, and reduce the cooldown by {{ticks}}. Reduce the energy cost of Impaling Strike by {{energy}}.

detonationCatalyst.name: BOGO Bomb
detonationCatalyst.description: Reduce the cooldown of Volatile Brew by {{ticks}} and increase the duration by {{ticks}}. Both effects of Volatile Brew activate when it explodes.

superBrew.name: Super Brew
superBrew.description: Replace Volatile Brew with Super Brew.

swiftJustice.name: Swift Justice
swiftJustice.description: Reduce the cooldown of Vindicate by {{ticks}} and it can now be recasted, which cleanses slowness and grants full knockback and slow immunity, {{speed;%}} speed for {{ticks}}, and increases the damage of the next Righteous Strike by {{damage;%}} and the active ability reduction by {{ticks}}.

righteousRampage.name: Righteous Rampage
righteousRampage.description: Lose {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction. Replace Heart to Heart with Bull Rush. Soul Shackle damages all enemies within a {{blocks}} radius for {{damage;%}} damage. Reduce the duration of the VIND effect from Vindicate by {{ticks}}. Vindicate can be recasted to perform a huge leap, which will damage all enemies within {{blocks}} for {{damage}} damage and deal massive knockback upon landing.

abyssalGrasp.name: Abyssal Grasp
abyssalGrasp.description: Increase the damage of Soul Shackle by {{damage}} and reduce the range to {{blocks}}. Soul Shackle now pulls the target directly in front of you. Has reduced effect on flag carriers.

vitalPulse.name: Vital Pulse
vitalPulse.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Reduce the cooldown of Heart to Heart by {{ticks}} and increase the healing by {{heal}}.

sanctionBurst.name: Cold Shoulder
sanctionBurst.description: Heart to Heart can now target enemies, and resets the cooldown of Soul Shackle. Reduce the damage of Soul Shackle by {{damage}}. Prism Guard explodes when it ends, dealing massive knockback to enemies in range and cleansing all debuffs and slow effects.

iceBlock.name: Ice Block
iceBlock.description: Increase the duration of Ice Barrier by {{ticks}}. Ice Barrier can be recasted after {{ticks}}, reducing the duration by {{ticks}} but becoming an ice block. Ice block prevents jumping, tremendously reduces movement speed, but prevents knockback and grants {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction.

sharpFangs.name: Sharp Fangs
sharpFangs.description: Increase the damage of Poisonous Hex by {{damage;%}}.

houseOfLife.name: House of Life
houseOfLife.description: Gain {{heal}} max health and {{energy}} max energy. Increase the healing of Energy Seer to {{heal;%}}.

stackulatorMax.name: Stackulator MAX
stackulatorMax.description: Increase the damage of PHEX by {{damage}}, but reduce its damaging ticks by 1. Soulfire Beam damage scale is now {{damage;%}} / {{damage;%}} / {{damage;%}}.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description: Gain {{energy}} energy per melee hit. Increase the damage reduction of Contagious Facade by {{damageReduction;%}}, and its activation effect is activated on use and does not override the nonactivation post effect.

airStrike.name: Air Strike
airStrike.description: Astral Plague will prevent you from moving and ascend you {{blocks}} into the air over {{ticks}}. Once at maximum height, you can only use Soulfire Beam, it has no cooldown, deals {{damage;%}} less damage, and has a maximum range of {{blocks}}. This will last for {{ticks}} or until you cast beam {{blue}} times, {{blue}} if it was on cooldown when Astral Plague was used.

radiantLight.name: Radiant Light
radiantLight.description: Increase the healing of Ray of Light by {{heal;%}}.

unmercifulHex.name: Unmerciful Hex
unmercifulHex.description: Increase the pierce against enemies of Merciful Hex by {{blue}}, and the damage by {{damage;%}}, but it no longer grants the second ally MHEX stacks. Ray of Light no longer cleanses allies. Sanctified Beacon no longer grants MHEX stacks.

consecratedBeacon.name: Consecrated Beacon
consecratedBeacon.description: Reduce the energy cost of Sanctified Beacon to {{energy}}, the cooldown by {{ticks;%}}, and increase the MHEX stacks granted by {{blue}}.

energyOversurge.name: Energy Oversurge
energyOversurge.description: Energy Seer has its cooldown reduced by {{ticks;%}}, grants an additional {{energy}} energy, but its energy loss is increased by {{energy;%}}.

holyNova.name: Holy Nova
holyNova.description: Divine Blessing heals allies more than {{blocks}} from you for an additional {{heal;%}} and deals {{damage}} damage to all enemies as it heals. Increase the cooldown of Divine Blessing by {{ticks;%}}.

divineShields.name: Divine Shields
divineShields.description: Increase the damage reduction granted by Fortifying Hex by {{damageReduction;%}}. Increase the shield health granted by Guardian Beam by {{damageReduction;%}}.

pactOfProtection.name: Pact of Protection
pactOfProtection.description: Reduce the cooldown of Mystical Barrier by {{ticks;%}}. If casted on a teammate, the target will gain {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction but you will receive {{damage;%}} more damage for the duration of Mystical Barrier.

sanctuaryOfRetribution.name: Sanctuary of Retribution
sanctuaryOfRetribution.description: Increase the damage reduction per FHEX stack granted by Sanctuary by {{damageReduction;%}}. During Sanctuary, allies with max stacks of FHEX now reflect damage reduced by FHEX back to the dealer.

ruinousHex.name: Ruinous Hex
ruinousHex.description: Increase the pierce against enemies of Fortifying Hex by {{blue}} and the damage by {{damage;%}}, but increase the energy cost by {{energy}}, reduce the pierce for allies by {{blue}}, and the damage reduction granted by {{damageReduction;%}}.

loneSentinel.name: Lone Sentinel
loneSentinel.description: Gain {{damageReduction;%}} damage resistance. Increase the healing of Energy Seer to {{heal;%}}. Reduce the pierce for allies of Fortifying Hex by {{blue}}. Mystical Barrier can only affect yourself.
